what: When the section title reaches 60% of the screen, English handwritten letters appear in a .08s sequence, hopping up 1rem and settling (.125s+.125s). After .45s the Korean subtitle below slides up from 20px below over .8s. Following blocks (list·button) come in after .3s from 30px below over .8s.

options.dur: Duration of one character bounce (sec), default .125
options.sub-at: Time from letters starting to settle until the subtitle (sec), default .45
options.[data-fx-part=letters]: English line to split into letters. Required
options.[data-fx-part=follow]: Block that rises in sequence after the title (if present, together after .3s)

from.where: index.html .kc-title (English title in Oleo Script for each section)
